messages:
sarah_support: FYI incoming customer escalation — multiple tenants reporting intermittent 502/504s and timeouts to hosted inference endpoints in eu-central-1. Customers: AcmeApp + two smaller users. Seeing p95 spikes and gateway errors.

alex_oncall: @maria_netops can you pull interconnect/carrier metrics? Is this a provider-side event or our edge? :rotating_light:

maria_netops: looking. NLG transit graphs show increased retransmits and packet drops on upstream transit X at ~11:03 UTC, coincident with route churn from provider. BGP adj-flap logs show a withdraw -> announce cycle around that time.

sarah_support: AcmeApp provided this repro: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":64}'` -> intermittent `502 Bad Gateway` and `504 Gateway Timeout`. They see failures for ~30s every ~5m.

raj_engineering: can we get a sample gateway log? I want the upstream upstream error codes and internal 5xx reasons (connection reset, read timeout, 503 from backend, etc).

observability-bot: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.internal/snap/0a1b2c - p50/p95/p99 token latency and envoy 502 rate. Netflow shows egress packet-loss ~2-4% to transit X for affected AZs (eu-central-1a/b).

maria_netops: digging into provider NOC tickets — provider reports "maintenance grooming" that caused transient route flips on a subset of PoPs. We're seeing microbursts + head-of-line retransmits across the egress path.

alex_oncall: mitigation steps: 1) shift traffic away from transit X for affected prefixes (reroute to transit Y), 2) increase connection-retries/backoff at gateway for brief window, 3) enable soft-fail to standby model variant for critical tenants. Can infra make a policy change to route?

raj_engineering: I can push a short-lived routing override to prefer transit Y for the problem ASNs. Also roll a quick envoy config to increase upstream timeout from 10s -> 15s and add `idle_timeout` tweaks for streaming endpoints. Will monitor.

sarah_support: Notifying impacted customers and opening RCA channel. Will ask AcmeApp for request_id samples and timestamps.

maria_netops: FYI packet captures on edge show retransmit bursts and out-of-order segments causing TLS stalls (SACKs). Looks like hairpin + asymmetric path during grooming. Provider NOC confirms partial convergence.

sarah_support: AcmeApp provided two request_ids: r_0a1 and r_0a2 at 11:04:12 and 11:04:37 UTC. They included curl trace showing `Recv failure: Connection was reset`.

raj_engineering: Found matching traces in tracing: upstream connection reset -> envoy returns 502. Correlates to the egress packet loss window. Implemented route override at 11:10 UTC. Will continue to monitor for 15m.

observability-bot: After override: envoy 502 rate dropped ~85% in affected AZs, p95 latency returned to baseline. Netflow shows packet-loss on transit X tapering off after 11:18 UTC.

maria_netops: Provider reports grooming completed and routes stabilized at 11:16 UTC. We'll keep a watch for any residual flapping.

alex_oncall: Actions: (1) open provider escalation ticket requesting postmortem, (2) run a targeted repro job for AcmeApp with `--repeat` to ensure no regression, (3) add temporary routing health checks to detect transit microbursts and failover faster.

sarah_support: I'll send customer update summarizing mitigation and ETA for root cause follow-up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria_netops: adding recommendation to NOC playbook: detect BGP grooming windows and pre-warm alternate transit paths for hosted inference egress to reduce hairpin risk.

raj_engineering: later we'll add a small circuit-breaker in the gateway to shift heavy streaming sessions off a degraded transit earlier.

sarah_support: closing tenant-facing incident for now; marking internal incident P2. If any recurrence, reopen thread.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by alex_oncall at 11:11 UTC.

alex_oncall: leaving a short note for postmortem: include packet captures, provider route updates, envoy per-route 502 counts, and customer repro traces.
